question: Should generic transient tool-progress intent become a supported public reply-payload plugin-SDK contract, or remain an internal producer-to-channel runtime fact?
rationale: The branch exports a reusable constant and predicate through a public third-party plugin boundary; code review cannot decide whether OpenClaw intends to support that external contract permanently.

options.title: Keep Intent Internal
options.body: Carry the typed transient-progress fact through internal runtime structures without adding a new third-party plugin API.

options.title: Accept Public Contract
options.body: Document and support the generic marker as a durable API for external producers and channel plugins.

recommendation.title: Keep Intent Internal
recommendation.body: Carry the typed transient-progress fact through internal runtime structures without adding a new third-party plugin API.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work owns the overlapping Slack delivery paths and contributes to the existing progress-kind seam.
